Only the prose decoration receives explicit horizontal scale/translation to cover the actual emitted Korean word/phrase ink (plus explicitly declared unchanged native numeral/notation). Mathematical rules, table borders and other figure paths retain the independent1e-7 coordinate check.
prose_vector_decorations.previous_review_before_full_phrase_fit: Source-bound underline and its Korean counterpart reviewed; exact original vector program, colour, physical width and vertical coordinates remain unchanged; only horizontal placement follows the corresponding Korean emphasis.

outlined_vector_labels.source_font_size_basis: No font or point-size metadata exists: original Form glyph_count=0. Physical vertical em scale and baseline inferred by fitting the reviewed original English outline ink height to the arial.ttf outline role; exact original font/point metadata is not asserted. This inference is separate from the strict directly measured body/math typography.

font_policy: IChO2019 native Latin/math font dictionaries and glyph programs remain unchanged. Korean prose uses Noto CJK serif/sans/bold source-style roles, source italic angles and exact source physical point sizes/baselines.
